$note: Exceptions for scripts/check-i18n.mjs. Every entry carries a reason. "hardcodedText.max" is a ratchet: the guard tells you when a sweep lets you lower it, and fails if it grows. Deleting an entry is the definition of done for that file.
$backlog: Opened in one go when the hard-coded-text detector stopped relying on accents alone. Since then the capture cockpit (282 code literals + 19 template lines), chat-panel (28), chat-workspace, client360 (12 template lines), knowledge-view, knowledge-base, sse.service, vp-meeting, vp-agenda-timeline, vp-press-article-drawer, workspace/general and the mission-room template half reached zero and their entries were deleted. What remains under DEBT is the mission-room pair (mission-room.component.ts, mission-control-monitor.component.ts): seeded scenario content and real chrome interleaved in the same class bodies, which needs a fixture/chrome split before the numbers can move.

src/app/features/mission-room/mission-co.reason: Seeded French demo content ("Sentence du jour") and a French proper noun (Côte d'Ivoire) in the mission-room scenario. The plan classes seeded scenario content as data, not chrome; the proper noun stays French in both locales.

src/app/features/workspace/chat-knowledg.reason: Permanent. The accented lines are `placeholder` examples of the French values an admin types into this form — stop phrases ("on peut s'arrêter là") and synonym lists for the French voice gateway. The sample must be in the language of the data, not of the chrome; translating it would show the admin an example they cannot use. The chrome that used to share this entry moved to chrome.dict.ts in the P2 i18n sweep.

$hardcodedCodeNote: Two kinds of entry live below, and the difference matters. A DATA entry is permanent: the literal is scenario content, a backend contract value or a sample in the language of the data, and translating it would be wrong. A DEBT entry is a ratchet at its measured value: it is real French chrome that nobody has moved to a key yet, the number may only go down, and the entry is deleted when it reaches zero. Never turn a DEBT entry into a DATA entry to make the guard green.
